description.text: Students, who complete the training program within the stipulated period, in accordance with the national degree-granting regulations, will be awarded a postgraduate certificate and a master degree. Those who fail the examinations will be issued a course-completion certificate or other proof certificates.

duration.text: The Radiology at Jining Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for duration of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6. Undergraduate school transcript 7. HSK Certificate.

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
